# orchestration_cluster_role_member_mapping_rule (Resource)

Assigns a mapping rule to a Camunda cluster role

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orchestration_cluster_role" "ops" {
  role_id = "ops"
  name    = "Ops"
}

resource "orchestration_cluster_mapping_rule" "admin" {
  mapping_rule_id = "admin-mapping"
  claim_name      = "groups"
  claim_value     = "admin"
  name            = "Admin Mapping"
}

resource "orchestration_cluster_role_member_mapping_rule" "admin" {
  role_id         = orchestration_cluster_role.ops.role_id
  mapping_rule_id = orchestration_cluster_mapping_rule.admin.mapping_rule_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mapping_rule_id` (String) The ID of the mapping rule.
- `role_id` (String) The ID of the role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID of the assignment (percent-encoded `role_id/mapping_rule_id`). Also used as the import ID: `terraform import orchestration_cluster_role_member_mapping_rule.example <role_id>/<mapping_rule_id>`, with each component percent-encoded if it contains a `/`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import orchestration_cluster_role_member_mapping_rule.admin ops/admin-mapping
```
